# MOMOBLOBS

> MOMOBLOBS (momoblobs.com) is a free online games website — 3D runners, racing, action and brain games — starring Momo (an orange clay blob who hides), Kranky (a crab in a top hat), Tiki (a teal bird), Pip (a forgetful penguin), Gloop (a one-toothed slime), Prof. Hoot (a sleepy owl), Noodle (a very long sausage dog), Zib (a one-eyed alien), Bolt (a beeping robot), Bonbon (a hippo cake chef) and Turbo (a snail with a rocket shell). No sign-up, no downloads; progress is saved in the browser.

## Games
- [Nitro Rush](https://momoblobs.com/games/nitro-rush): big 3D car racing game — 29 themed worlds, 34 unlockable cars and trucks (F1 car, monster truck, buggy, bus, fire truck and more), career, quick race, Coin Rush single-drive mode, elimination, time trial and boss duels; nitro, drifting, slipstream and takedowns. Racing.
- [Drift Kings](https://momoblobs.com/games/drift-kings): 3D drifting and rally game — drift chains with a ×5 multiplier, tandem Drift Battles against a rival, rally stages on dirt, sand and snow with co-driver pace notes, Coin Rush and races; 27 venues (touge passes, harbour at night, neon highway, desert and snow rallies, the Moon) and 33 unlockable drift and rally cars. Racing.
- [Highway Heat](https://momoblobs.com/games/highway-heat): 3D highway traffic and police chase game — weave through cars, vans, buses and big rigs for near-miss combos, outrun police with roadblocks and a BUSTED meter, or be the cop and ram the suspects in Takedown; 27 highways and 32 unlockable cars. Racing.
- [Moto Rush GP](https://momoblobs.com/games/moto-rush): 3D motorbike Grand Prix game — bikes lean into corners with the rider hanging off, wheelies on the straights (Wheelie Challenge), slipstream and nitro; qualifying, Grands Prix and title duels on 27 circuits with 32 unlockable bikes (sport, naked, supermoto, scooter, cruiser, café racer, chopper, electric). Racing.
- [Blob Brigade](https://momoblobs.com/games/blob-brigade): 3D crowd game — start with one Momo blob, walk onto +1 tiles and pick the best math gate (+10 or ×2) to grow a brigade, merge 10 blobs into Big Blobs, break bonus jars, free caged blobs and bubble a marching crowd of Grumpies back to happy; 100 fast stages across 10 worlds (Garden Path, Candy Kitchen, Snowy Peaks, Toy Room, Beach Day, Spooky Night, Jungle Ruins, Lava Land, Space Station, Kranky's Castle), each world with its own twist (ice, toy blocks, surf waves, darkness, boulders, lava vents, meteors) and every stage ending with a villain to dodge; 11 leaders with POWER moves, a coin upgrade shop, power-up tiles, hats and bubble colours; after stage 100 an endless Remix Loop, plus a Daily Challenge, Boss Rush and Endless Waves.
- [Momo Boing!](https://momoblobs.com/games/momo-boing): 3D bouncing climber — Momo bounces by himself, you steer him up through the sky onto clay platforms; tap as he lands for a Perfect Boing (every landing plays the next note of the song), chain five into a Comet, pop friend bubbles so the MOMOBLOBS gang stacks on Momo's head as extra lives with powers, pick power cards on Safe Clouds and stay ahead of the rising Grumpy Goo; 100 stages that come one by one across 10 sky worlds (Garden Sky, Candy Clouds, Snow Peaks, Toy Tower, Beach Breeze, Spooky Night, Jungle Canopy, Lava Sky, Space, Cloud Castle), each with its own platforms, music and villain; after stage 100 new stages keep coming forever (two worlds mixed, new skies, weather and twists, slowly harder), plus a Daily Sky, a ghost race against your best try, an Endless Climb and a hat/trail Wardrobe.
- [Momo Dash!](https://momoblobs.com/games/momo-dash): 3D endless runner — Momo runs by itself; swipe left/right to change lanes, up to jump, down to squish; every run starts at Sunset Pier and keeps going through 12 worlds (Candy Town, Jungle Ruins, Snowy Village, Toy Factory, Spooky Fair, Canyon Mines, Neon City, Lava Works, Sky Islands, Space Port, Grumpy Castle), each adding a new piece (jelly trams, gaps, ice, conveyor belts, ghost blocks, rails, traffic, geysers, wind), then mixed worlds forever; speed climbs in waves; star-power boosters (×3 for 6 s, golden ×5 for 9 s), morph gates (ball, split, giant, stretch), Coin Lane / Star Lane portals, coin melodies, tricks, a friend conga line, Jelly Boards, missions with a score multiplier, a Daily Dash and a shop.
- [Kiko's Jungle Quest](https://momoblobs.com/games/kiko-jungle-quest): 3D jungle runner — Kiko the monkey runs by himself to win back the 15 Golden Seeds; swipe left/right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide, tap to grab a vine or zipline; every run starts at Kiko's Treehouse and flows through 15 regions and 300 named places (Banana Grove, Mango River, Bamboo Valley, Waterfall Cliffs, Mushroom Hollow, Monsoon Marsh, Canopy Heights, Firefly Night Woods, Blossom Hills, Crystal Caves, Autumn Maple Woods, Elephant Plains, Misty Mangroves, Snowpine Peaks, Volcano Jungle), then the Wild Forest mixes them forever; each region has its own music, weather and hazards (vine swings, branch roads, rafts, waterslides, ziplines, kites, collapsing bridges, mud, ice, geysers, wind gusts, spider webs, lava stepping stones), an animal ride (turtle, red panda, frog, elephant, pelican, sled, dino…), chasers (bees, bats, stampede, avalanche, boulder) and a boss chase for a Golden Seed (hit 3 banana pads); hearts with banana-flag checkpoints, fruits and Smoothie Rush, pepper-rocket boosters, Pico the toucan's hints and glide, a Sticker Album, a Treehouse to decorate, missions with a score multiplier, a Daily Jungle Hunt and a shop.
- [Momo Sky Roll](https://momoblobs.com/games/sky-roll): 3D rolling-ball music game — Momo curls into a clay ball and rolls along floating sky paths to the beat; drag to steer, jump pads, boost arrows, hazards that move to the music (mallets, spinners, lasers, crushers, barrels); one endless run through 20 worlds (Clay Garden, Candy Kitchen, Ice Floe, Neon Night, Space Port, Volcano Forge…) each with its own music style, then 217 concepts fuse into new track forever; coins, hearts, 30-second rocket boosters, 11 rollers, Concept Dex, Daily Fusion, Boss Rush and a Concept Lab level builder.
- [Rollo Rush](https://momoblobs.com/games/rollo-rush): endless 3D speed run made for phones, with a story — a voiced cinematic opening where Mayamma the Sky Witch (a spooky floating ghost-witch in a white saree) snatches Rollo's little brother Chintu, then every second stage she swoops back and throws 220 different magics from 11 elements (fire bombs, ice spears, poison puddles, thunder rings, halo traps…) that Rollo must dodge, plus a signature obstacle per stage (pop-up logs, falling boulders, giant hammers, rolling wheels, geysers…), gold coins, power orbs and hearts that are saved lives; Rollo, an athletic armoured pangolin, sprints down one road that never stops (each stretch joins straight onto the next; no stage menus, it resumes at the last checkpoint) through 25 worlds from Moonlit Bay and Candy Canyon to Neon Night City, Sky Islands, Deep Sea Tubes, Orbit Ring and Kranky's Sky Fortress; one-thumb controls (drag to steer, swipe up to hop, swipe down to curl into his glowing Curl Ball, tap for a Burst), 500 ideas taught one per stretch — rails, loops, corkscrews, wall runs, lily pads, cannons, gates and keys, chases, races, view twists and 25 Kranky boss machines — getting faster and busier as you go, then an endless Remix Run that never repeats a mix; every stretch is checked by a fair-play robot runner with human reaction times, with a cinematic camera, music that changes as you run and pearl chimes in the song’s key; plus Endless Moon Run, Daily Sprint, Time Trial (race your ghost), Boss Rush and Trick Park modes, a Concept Dex with Mayamma's spellbook, and Rollo's Locker for cosmetic colours.
- [Momo Jelly Jam](https://momoblobs.com/games/momo-jelly-jam): 3D jelly block puzzle — drag glossy jelly pieces with little faces through a toy tray, push same-colour pieces together into a perfect rectangle so they squish into one block, then slide it out through the gate of its colour that is exactly its size; one endless journey with no stage select (it resumes on the exact same board) through 20 themed 3D worlds and 1,200 stages that teach 400 puzzle ideas — turn and flip pads, belts, ice, mud, teleports, switches and doors, keys and locks, crates, pits and bridges, floor drains and packing boxes, stone, gold, rainbow, heavy, ghost and bubble jellies, colour mixing and paint, gravity, wind, magnets, wrap-around trays, fog, clocks, move limits, exit orders and Kranky boss tricks, with trays that grow trickier world after world and soft ASMR sounds tuned to each stage’s music — then the Fusion Jam mixes them forever; plus Daily Jam, Kranky Weekly, Rush, Zen, Puzzle Packs, a Jam Lab, a Concept Dex, a Jelly Shop and 13 helpers; every stage is proven solvable before you see it, with Undo, Restart, Hints and 3-star par.
- [Momo Escape](https://momoblobs.com/games/momo-escape): 3D swipe escape game — swipe up, down, left or right and Momo dashes wall to wall through Kranky's buildings (he only moves when you say so), dodge lasers, crushers, turrets and saws, collect coins and 3 diamonds per floor, find the EXIT hatch; 24 buildings then endless concept mixes (every floor checked by a solver), Daily Heist, Speed Series and a Room Lab.
- [Momo Shuffle](https://momoblobs.com/games/momo-shuffle): free online cup game (shell game). Momo hides under a cup, Kranky shuffles, the player taps the right cup. Easy = 3 cups, Medium = 4 cups, Hard = 6 cups. Unlimited levels, coins for each correct find, streak bonuses, twists (Zigzag, Fake-Out, Triple Spin, Lights Off) and bonus rounds every 5th level. Ages 4+.
- [Fish Watch](https://momoblobs.com/games/fish-watch): multiple-object tracking with Pip the penguin — remember the golden fish, follow them through the shuffle, tap them. Focus/memory.
- [Spot the Sneak](https://momoblobs.com/games/spot-the-sneak): find the one Gloop slime that is different in a dancing crowd. Focus.
- [Color Clash](https://momoblobs.com/games/color-clash): Stroop game with Prof. Hoot — tap the INK colour or the WORD colour. Focus/brain.
- [Blink!](https://momoblobs.com/games/blink-change): spot what changed in Noodle the sausage dog's room after he blinks. Focus/memory.
- [Where's Zib?](https://momoblobs.com/games/where-is-zib): find Zib, the one-eyed purple alien, in a busy space party. Focus.
- [Memory Bridge](https://momoblobs.com/games/memory-bridge): sequence memory with Tiki the bird — stones light up with musical notes, hop across in the same order (Backwards, Decoy and Fog twists). Memory.
- [Pip's Pantry](https://momoblobs.com/games/pips-pantry): pairs memory behind fridge doors full of clay food; Kranky swaps closed doors on harder levels. Memory.
- [Bolt's Beep Boop](https://momoblobs.com/games/bolt-beeps): Simon-style sound and colour sequence game with Bolt the robot (Backwards and Glitch-shuffle twists; every button also has a shape for colour-blind players). Memory.
- [Order Up!](https://momoblobs.com/games/order-up): remember a customer's cake and build it layer by layer in Bonbon the hippo's cake shop; toppings and double orders at higher levels. Memory.
- [Glow Grid](https://momoblobs.com/games/grid-glow): visual pattern memory — tap the squares that glowed on a 3×3 to 7×7 neon grid (In Order and Rotate twists). Memory.
- [Shadow Snap](https://momoblobs.com/games/shadow-match): Match the clay shadow to the right character. Host: Noodle. Category: focus.
- [Gloop Guard](https://momoblobs.com/games/gloop-guard): You're the party door guard. Green Gloops in, red Gloops out! Host: Gloop. Category: focus/speed.
- [Who Said It?](https://momoblobs.com/games/who-said-it): Characters make funny noises — tap them in the same order. Host: Gloop. Category: memory.
- [What's Missing?](https://momoblobs.com/games/whats-missing): Kranky stole something from the shelf. What is it? Host: Kranky. Category: memory.
- [Pick the Door](https://momoblobs.com/games/pick-the-door): Kranky hides Momo behind a door. Read the clues and pick the right one! Host: Kranky. Category: brain/puzzle.
- [Pattern Parade](https://momoblobs.com/games/pattern-parade): Shapes march in a pattern. Pick what comes next. Host: Prof. Hoot. Category: brain.
- [Odd Blob Out](https://momoblobs.com/games/odd-blob-out): One blob breaks the rule. Find it! Host: Zib. Category: brain.
- [Balance Buddies](https://momoblobs.com/games/balance-buddies): See-saws show who is heavier. Who's heaviest of all? Host: Prof. Hoot. Category: brain.
- [Whack-a-Gloop](https://momoblobs.com/games/whack-a-gloop): Bonk every Gloop — but never bonk Momo! Host: Gloop. Category: speed.
- [Turbo Dash](https://momoblobs.com/games/turbo-dash): The slowest snail with the fastest rocket. Host: Turbo. Category: speed.
- [Bake Drop](https://momoblobs.com/games/bake-drop): Catch the cake bits, dodge the chilli peppers! Host: Bonbon. Category: speed.
- [Quick Draw](https://momoblobs.com/games/quick-hoot): Wait… wait… NOW! Don't fall for the fakes. Host: Prof. Hoot. Category: speed/focus.
- [Count Fast](https://momoblobs.com/games/count-fast): Momos bounce onto the stage. Count them before the curtain drops! Host: Momo. Category: numbers.
- [Sum Slices](https://momoblobs.com/games/sum-slices): Tap cake slices that add up to Bonbon's number. Host: Bonbon. Category: numbers.
- [Number Ninja](https://momoblobs.com/games/number-ninja): Find the numbers in order as fast as you can. Host: Noodle. Category: numbers/focus.
- [More or Less](https://momoblobs.com/games/more-or-less): Two jelly jars — pick the one with more beans before Turbo reaches the flag! Host: Turbo. Category: numbers.
- [Slide Ship](https://momoblobs.com/games/slide-ship): Slide the tiles to fix Zib's crashed UFO. Host: Zib. Category: puzzle.
- [Gloop Pipes](https://momoblobs.com/games/gloop-pipes): Rotate the pipes so slime reaches every cup. Host: Gloop. Category: puzzle.
- [Firefly Switch](https://momoblobs.com/games/firefly-switch): Each jar flips its neighbours. Light them all! Host: Noodle. Category: puzzle.
- [Maze Munch](https://momoblobs.com/games/maze-munch): Guide Momo through the clay maze. Host: Momo. Category: puzzle.
- All 36 games are live. Every game has Easy/Medium/Hard, unlimited levels that never repeat, scores, combos and coins.

## Facts
- Price: free. Platforms: any modern browser on phone, tablet or computer; installable as a home-screen app.
- Data: no accounts; coins/levels/settings stored in localStorage on the player's device.
- Channels: YouTube @momoblobs, Instagram @momoblobs (daily cup-challenge videos with the same characters).
